messages:
mariana: Quick sync — Lima region (new cloud region) preflight. Need owners for routing policy, KMS residency, DB replica plan, and a short list of must-pass smoke tests. Also calling out any legal/data residency blockers. TL;DR: cutover target W+2; want owners by EOD tomorrow.

andrew: I can take routing policy and peering config. Will post a draft route policy and egress plan later today.

kevin: I’ll own KMS and key provisioning. Question: do we need a separate key ring scoped to the customer residency bucket or reuse sa-east1 ring?

mariana: prefer new key ring scoped to lima-region for audit clarity (legal asked for separate ring). kevin can you estimate time?

kevin: should be ~2 work hours to create key ring + IAM bindings, plus 1hr for ops runbook.

samir: DB replicas — we have two options: async read replica in lima or regional read-only replica via cross-region replication. For low-latency reads close to customers, local read replica makes sense but increases ops. Which does product prefer?

natalie: product prefers local read replica for compliance and perf. We'll accept the ops cost if latency improves.

mariana: ok samir please draft the replica runbook. note: ensure backups retained per retention policy in /docs/data-residency.

andrew: routing policy draft (WIP):
```yaml
route-policy:
  - match: src=public-api, region=lima
    prefer: lima-gw
    fallback: sa-east1-gw
  - egress-nat: use-shared-nat=false
    egress-egress-tier: premium
```
I’ll post full PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/PR-6543

mariana: pinging eng-security for quick checklist on encryption in transit and egress controls @kevin FYI.

infra-bot: CI pipeline: PR-6543 lint OK, tests pending. See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/6543

kevin: noted re: encryption. I’ll add KMS bindings and a short checklist to the PR. Also double-check HSM requirements for enterprise customers; if HSM required we need procurement lead time.

samir: replica plan: initial stand-up (db01-lima-read), promote path documented, failover will remain manual for first week. Putting runbook in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/PR-6547

mariana: thanks. action items:
- andrew: finalize routing policy PR + add traffic shaping rules (due EOD)
- kevin: create key ring + runbook (due EOD)
- samir: replica runbook + backup retention config (due EOD)
- natalie: confirm product acceptance criteria (latency, residency) by EOD
If anyone can't meet EOD ping here asap.

andrew: one more Q — can we reuse sa-east1 egress IP pools for initial testing or do we need unique egress?

mariana: testing can use sa-east1 pools as long as we document the exception and ensure audit entry. Production needs region-specific egress.

natalie: product OK with testing exception.

kevin: FYI I opened a quick ticket for HSM lead time: https://tracker.redwood-inference/tickets/7891

mariana: great — if no blockers we’ll run a smoke window next Thurs 09:00-11:00 UTC. I'll schedule with oncall. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

samir: ack, will stand by for the window and final playbook.

andrew: will queue the PR review, @kevin @natalie please review routing/keys once posted.

mariana: thanks team — posting minutes to the region-plans doc after this thread. If anything else pops up put it here.
